beschreibung: G3 (#311): Bot-Porträts, rund beschnitten im Spielerchip. Die Bots sind Uhrwerk-Automaten des Barock (Aufziehschlüssel als gemeinsames Erkennungszeichen), kein Steampunk; erst ein Probelauf mit vorausrechner, admiral und reizkeiler.
stil: Painterly warm baroque oil portrait of a whimsical storybook animal character of a fairy-tale kingdom, a fixture of a medieval tavern gaming table: warm candlelight, rich textures, dark warm background with subtle damask pattern, gentle friendly expression with a clever twinkle, humorous but dignified. The character is an exquisite 18th-century clockwork automaton built by a master craftsman to play games with the guests: a polished brass wind-up key on its back, clearly visible behind one shoulder, fine brass seams at the joints, warm glossy glass eyes, still clearly a charming storybook animal with fur or feathers and fabric clothing. Bust portrait facing the viewer, head and shoulders fully inside the image, centred with space around so it can be cropped to a circle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
